hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Protocol vaults. Handles swaps entirely in beforeSwap using its own curve pricing (CurveLib), depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, and returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard pool math. Liquidity additions and donations are blocked by design.
